## 8/1/2023
```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache = TRUE)

# Straight trends on (S^1)^2
set.seed(50)
n <- 60
nspheres <- 2
samp_1 <- r_path_s1r(n = n, r = nspheres, k = rep(1, nspheres), angles = TRUE)

plot(samp_1,
  xlim = c(-pi, pi), ylim = c(-pi, pi), col = rainbow(n),
  axes = TRUE, xlab = "Angle 1", ylab = "Angle 2",main="(S^1)^2 Data", pch = 16
)
clusters <- samp_1

dims = rep(1,nspheres)
angular = TRUE
landmark_size = 1
# compare centroids to nearest points to centroids
landmarks <- get_center(x = clusters, dims = dims, angular = angular, landmark_size = landmark_size)
landmarks_centroids <- get_centroids(x = clusters, dims = dims, angular = angular, landmark_size = landmark_size)
plot(clusters[landmarks,],
  xlim = c(-pi, pi), ylim = c(-pi, pi), col = rep('black',n),
  axes = TRUE, xlab = "Angle 1", ylab = "Angle 2", main="Nearest neighbors of centroids, landmark size = 10%", pch = 16
)
plot(polySphereToAngles(landmarks_centroids,dims)-pi,
  xlim = c(-pi, pi), ylim = c(-pi, pi), col = rep('black',n),
  axes = TRUE, xlab = "Angle 1", ylab = "Angle 2", main="Centroids of clusters, landmark size = 10%", pch = 16
)

```

```{r}
# Straight trends on (S^1)^2
knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache = TRUE)

set.seed(50)
n <- 200
nspheres <- 2
samp_2 <- r_path_s2r(n = n, r = nspheres, sigma = 0.05)

clusters <- samp_2[, , 1]
for (i in (2:nspheres)) {
  clusters <- cbind(clusters, samp_2[, , i])
}

dims = rep(2,nspheres)
angular = FALSE
landmark_size = .1
# compare centroids to nearest points to centroids
landmarks <- get_center(x = clusters, dims = dims, angular = angular, landmark_size = landmark_size)
landmarks_centroids <- get_centroids(x = clusters, dims = dims, angular = angular, landmark_size = landmark_size)
scatterplot3d::scatterplot3d(
  samp_2[, , 1],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", main="S^2 data, first sphere", color = rainbow(n), pch = 16
)
scatterplot3d::scatterplot3d(
  samp_2[landmarks,, 1],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "",main="Nearest neighbors of centroids of first sphere", color = rep('black',n*landmark_size), pch = 16
)
scatterplot3d::scatterplot3d(
  landmarks_centroids[,1:3],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "",main="Centroids of first sphere",  color = rep('black',n*landmark_size), pch = 16
)

scatterplot3d::scatterplot3d(
  samp_2[, , 2],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", main="S^2 data, second sphere", color = rainbow(n), pch = 16
)
scatterplot3d::scatterplot3d(
  samp_2[landmarks, , 2],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "",main="Nearest neighbors of centroids of second sphere", color = rep('black',n*landmark_size), pch = 16
)
scatterplot3d::scatterplot3d(
  landmarks_centroids[,4:6],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "",main="Centroids of second sphere",  color = rep('black',n*landmark_size), pch = 16
)
```

```{r}
# Straight trends on (S^1)^2
```
```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache = TRUE)

set.seed(180)
n <- 200
nspheres <- 2
samp_1 <- r_path_s1r(n = n, r = nspheres, k = rep(1, nspheres), angles = TRUE)

plot(samp_1,
  xlim = c(-pi, pi), ylim = c(-pi, pi), col = rainbow(n),
  axes = TRUE, xlab = "Angle 1", ylab = "Angle 2",main="(S^1)^2 Data", pch = 16
)
clusters <- samp_1

dims = rep(1,nspheres)
angular = TRUE
landmark_size = .3


time <- Sys.time()
res_centroid <- plot_MDS_py(clusters, landmark_size = .1, dims=dims, angular=angular, landmark_tol = 5e-4, tol = 5e-4, landmarks_centroid = TRUE)
# profvis({res_int <- plot_MDS_py(clusters, landmark_size = .1, landmark_tol=5e-6)})
centroid_time <- Sys.time() - time


time <- Sys.time()
res_subset <- plot_MDS_py(clusters, landmark_size = .1, dims= dims, angular = angular, landmark_tol=5e-4,tol=5e-4, landmarks_centroid = FALSE)
# profvis({res <- plot_MDS(clusters)})
subset_time <- Sys.time() - time


time <- Sys.time()
res <- plot_MDS(clusters,dims=dims, angular=angular,tol=5e-4)
# profvis({res <- plot_MDS(clusters)})
normal_time<- Sys.time() - time

residual_centroids1 <- sum(res_centroid[,1]-res[,1])^2/var(res[,1])
residual_subset1 <- sum(res_subset[,1]-res[,1])^2/var(res[,1])
residual_centroids2 <- sum(res_centroid[,2]-res[,2])^2/var(res[,2])
residual_subset2 <- sum(res_subset[,2]-res[,2])^2/var(res[,2])
score_residuals <- c(residual_centroids1,residual_subset1,residual_centroids2,residual_subset2)
times <- c(normal_time, centroid_time,subset_time)
print(score_residuals)
print(times)

```

```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache = TRUE)

#test permutation
# Straight trends on (S^1)^2
set.seed(10)
n <- 200
nspheres <- 2
samp_1 <- r_path_s1r(n = n, r = nspheres, k = rep(1, nspheres), angles = TRUE)

plot(samp_1,
  xlim = c(-pi, pi), ylim = c(-pi, pi), col = rainbow(n),
  axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "", pch = 16
)
clusters <- samp_1

clusters2 <- clusters[sample(nrow(clusters)),]

dims = rep(1,nspheres)
angular = TRUE
landmark_size = .2
tol = 5e-4
landmark_tol = 5e-4

x <- clusters
n <- nrow(x)
    d <- ncol(x)
    d_sphere <- sum(dims)

    ls <- n * landmark_size

    if (is.null(col)) {
      col <- rep("black", n)
    }

    # Initial guess for radius is number of spheres in polysphere
    r_star <- sqrt(length(dims)) # Compare sum of squares

    # Compute polysphere indices [s^d_1, s^d_2...]
    ind_dj <- comp_ind_dj(dims)

    # convert from hyperspherical to cartesian coordinates if needed
    cart_x <- x
    if (angular) {
      cart_x <- polyAnglesToSphere(x, dims)
    }
    # go straight to upper/lower part
    dist <- dist_polysph_matrix(cart_x, ind_dj = ind_dj, std = FALSE)
    d_ij_polysphere <- dist[upper.tri(dist)]
    if (init == "cmds") {
      # Initialization by cmdscale
      y <-
        cmdscale(
          d = dist,
          k = d_sphere + 1,
          eig = FALSE,
          x.ret = FALSE
        )
      y <- y / sqrt(rowSums(y^2))
      y_initial <- y
      r_star_initial <- r_star
    }
    stress <- function(y, r_star, n, d_sphere, d_ij_polysphere) {
      r_star <- y[n * (d_sphere + 1) + 1] # r_star in optimization
      y <-
        matrix(y[1:(n * (d_sphere + 1))], nrow = n, ncol = d_sphere + 1)
      y <- y / sqrt(rowSums(y^2)) # Normalization of y

      dim(y) <- c(dim(y), 1) # As an array
      # Spherical distance
      ind_tri <- sphunif::upper_tri_ind(n)
      d_ij_sphere <- sphunif::Psi_mat(
        data = y,
        use_ind_tri = TRUE,
        ind_tri = ind_tri
      )

      d_ij_sphere <- drop(d_ij_sphere)
      # Stress function (only sum the distinct distances and disregard diagonal)
      return(sum((d_ij_polysphere - r_star * d_ij_sphere)^2) / length(d_ij_polysphere))
    }
    # either take landmarks as the centroids of clusters of the nearest point to the centroid
      landmarks <- get_centroids(x = x, dims = dims, angular = angular, landmark_size = landmark_size)
      #landmarks <- landmarks / sqrt(rowSums(landmarks^2))
      # project the landmarks onto the sphere
      dist_ls <- dist_polysph_matrix(landmarks, ind_dj = ind_dj, std = FALSE)
      d_ij_polysphere_ls <- dist_ls[upper.tri(dist_ls)]
      y_ls <-
        cmdscale(
          d = dist_ls,
          k = d_sphere + 1,
          eig = FALSE,
          x.ret = FALSE
        )
      d_sphere <- ncol(y_ls) - 1
      y_ls <- y_ls / sqrt(rowSums(y_ls^2))

      landmark_stress <- function(y, d_sphere, r_star,d_ij_polysphere_ls) {
        r_star <- y[ls * (d_sphere + 1) + 1] # r_star in optimization
        y <-
          matrix(y[1:(ls * (d_sphere + 1))], nrow = ls, ncol = d_sphere + 1)
        y <- y / sqrt(rowSums(y^2)) # Normalization of y

        dim(y) <- c(dim(y), 1) # As an array
        # Spherical distance
        ind_tri <- sphunif::upper_tri_ind(ls)
        d_ij_sphere <- sphunif::Psi_mat(
          data = y,
          use_ind_tri = TRUE,
          ind_tri = ind_tri
        )
        d_ij_sphere <- drop(d_ij_sphere)
        # Stress function (only sum the distinct distances and disregard diagonal)
        return(sum((d_ij_polysphere_ls - r_star * d_ij_sphere)^2) / length(d_ij_polysphere_ls))
      }

      # # Solves MDS for y given landmark centroids ls
      # remaining_stress <- function(y, yn, d_sphere, dims, n, yl, r_star, dist) {
      #   y1 <- rbind(yn, y)
      #   # landmark points defined outside the function
      #   y1 <-
      #     matrix(y[1:(n * (d_sphere + 1))], nrow = n, ncol = d_sphere + 1)
      #   y1 <- y1 / sqrt(rowSums(y1^2)) # Normalization of y
      #   y2 <- y1
      #   dim(y2) <- c(dim(y2), 1) # As an array
      #   # Spherical distance
      #   ind_tri <- sphunif::upper_tri_ind(n)
      #   d_ij_sphere <- sphunif::Psi_mat( # coerce to dist class
      #     data = y2,
      #     use_ind_tri = TRUE,
      #     ind_tri = ind_tri
      #   )
      #   ind_dj <- comp_ind_dj(d_sphere)
      #   sph_mat <- dist_polysph_cross(x = y1, y = yl, ind_dj = ind_dj, norm_x = FALSE, norm_y = FALSE, std = FALSE)
      #   landmark_polysphere <- dist
      #   # Stress function (only sum the distinct distances and disregard diagonal)
      #   return(sum((landmark_polysphere - r_star * sph_mat)^2) / length(landmark_polysphere))
      # }
      
 # Solves MDS for y given landmark centroids ls
      remaining_stress <- function(yp, yn, d_sphere, dims, n, yl, r_star, dist) {
        len_yp <- length(yp)/(d_sphere+1)
        # landmark points defined outside the function
        y1 <-
          matrix(yp[1:(len_yp * (d_sphere + 1))], nrow = len_yp, ncol = d_sphere + 1)
        y1 <- y1 / sqrt(rowSums(y1^2)) # Normalization of y
        y2 <- y1
        dim(y2) <- c(dim(y2), 1) # As an array
        # Spherical distance
        ind_tri <- sphunif::upper_tri_ind(len_yp)
        d_ij_sphere <- sphunif::Psi_mat( # coerce to dist class
          data = y2,
          use_ind_tri = TRUE,
          ind_tri = ind_tri
        )
        ind_dj <- comp_ind_dj(d_sphere)
        sph_mat <- dist_polysph_cross(x = y1, y = yl, ind_dj = ind_dj, norm_x = FALSE, norm_y = FALSE, std = FALSE)
        landmark_polysphere <- dist
        # Stress function (only sum the distinct distances and disregard diagonal)
        return(sum((landmark_polysphere - r_star * sph_mat)^2) / length(landmark_polysphere))
      }
#res1<- remaining_stress(yp=yp,yn=yn, r_star = r_star, yl = yl, d_sphere = d_sphere, n = n, dist = dist_initial)




      # Solve landmark MDS first
      res_landmark <- optim(
        fn = landmark_stress,
        par = c(y_ls, r_star), d_sphere = d_sphere,d_ij_polysphere_ls=d_ij_polysphere_ls,
        method = "BFGS",
        control = list(reltol = landmark_tol)
      )
      r_star <- res_landmark$par[ls * (d_sphere + 1) + 1] # r_star in optimization
      yl <-
        matrix(res_landmark$par[1:(ls * (d_sphere + 1))], nrow = ls, ncol = d_sphere + 1)
      yl <- yl / sqrt(rowSums(yl^2)) # Normalization of y

      ind_dj_poly <- comp_ind_dj(dims)
      # distances between original points and landmarks on the polysphere
      # dist_initial <- dist_polysph_cross(x = cart_x, y = landmarks, norm_x = TRUE, norm_y = TRUE, ind_dj = ind_dj_poly, std = FALSE)
      # y <-
      #   cmdscale(
      #     d = dist,
      #     k = d_sphere + 1,
      #     eig = FALSE,
      #     x.ret = FALSE
      #   )
      # y <- y / sqrt(rowSums(y^2))
      # y_initial <- y
    y <- array(0L,c(n,d_sphere+1))

    df_x <- as.data.frame(cart_x)
    df_l <- as.data.frame(landmarks)
    not_landmarks <- unique_indices(df_x,df_l)
    landmark_subset <- subset_indices(df_x,df_l)
    landmark_subset_direct <- subset_indices(df_l,df_x)
    #yp = y[not_landmarks,]
    yn = yl[landmark_subset_direct,]
    
    yp <-
        cmdscale(
          d = dist[not_landmarks,not_landmarks],
          k = d_sphere + 1,
          eig = FALSE,
          x.ret = FALSE
        )
      yp <- yp / sqrt(rowSums(yp^2))
      yp_initial <- yp
    if(length(not_landmarks) > 0){

      # # Compare landmarks to non-landmarks
      # res <- optim(
      #   fn = remaining_stress,
      #   par = c(y=yp),yn=yn, r_star = r_star, yl = yl, d_sphere = d_sphere, n = n, dist = dist_initial,
      #   method = "BFGS",
      #   control = list(reltol = tol)
      # )
      dist_initial <- dist_polysph_cross(x = cart_x[not_landmarks,], y = landmarks, norm_x = TRUE, norm_y = TRUE, ind_dj = ind_dj_poly, std = FALSE)
        res <- optim(
        fn = remaining_stress,
        par = c(yp),yn=yn, r_star = r_star, yl = yl, d_sphere = d_sphere, n = n, dist = dist_initial,
        method = "BFGS",
        control = list(reltol = tol)
      )

        y[not_landmarks,] <-
          matrix(res$par, nrow = nrow(yp), ncol = d_sphere + 1)
        y[landmark_subset,] <- yn
    } else{
      y <- yl
    }
 y_initial[landmark_subset,] <- yn
 y_initial[not_landmarks,] <- yp_initial
 stress_initial <- stress(
      y = c(y_initial, r_star_initial),
      r = r_star_initial, n = n, d_sphere = d_sphere, d_ij_polysphere = d_ij_polysphere
    )
    fun <- stress(c(y, r_star), r_star, n = n, d_sphere = d_sphere, d_ij_polysphere = d_ij_polysphere)
    # r.hat <- res$x[n * (d_sphere + 1) + 1]
    MDS_info <- list(
      stress_init = stress_initial,
      stress_final = fun,
      rstar = r_star_initial,
      r.hat = r_star
    )
    out <-
      matrix(y, nrow = n, ncol = d_sphere + 1)
    out <- out / sqrt(rowSums(out^2))
    print(MDS_info)
    general <-
      pns(t(out), sphere.type = "seq.test") # PNS with sequential testing for type of fitting sphere
    # Plotting
      plot3d(
        out,
        col = col,
        xlim = c(-1, 1),
        ylim = c(-1, 1),
        zlim = c(-1, 1)
      )
      plot(
        t(general$resmat),
        col = col,
        main = paste("First two Components, r* =", r_star),
        asp = 1
      )
```

```{r}
# returns indices of rows in first array that are not contained in second array
unique_indices <- function(arr1, arr2){
  inds <- 1:nrow(arr1)
  diff <- intersect(arr1,arr2)
  for (i in inds){
    if(nrow(intersect(arr1[i,],diff))>0){
      inds[i] = 0
    }
  }
  return(inds[inds != 0])
}

# returns indices of rows in first array that are contained in second array
subset_indices <- function(arr1, arr2){
  inds <- 1:nrow(arr1)
  diff <- intersect(arr1,arr2)
  for (i in inds){
    if(nrow(intersect(arr1[i,],diff))== 0){
      inds[i] = 0
    }
  }
  return(inds[inds != 0])
}
```

```{r}

 # Solves MDS for y given landmark centroids ls
      remaining_stress <- function(yp, yn, d_sphere, dims, n, yl, r_star, dist) {
        len_yp <- length(yp)/(d_sphere+1)
        # landmark points defined outside the function
        y1 <-
          matrix(yp[1:(len_yp * (d_sphere + 1))], nrow = len_yp, ncol = d_sphere + 1)
        y1 <- y1 / sqrt(rowSums(y1^2)) # Normalization of y
        y2 <- y1
        dim(y2) <- c(dim(y2), 1) # As an array
        # Spherical distance
        ind_tri <- sphunif::upper_tri_ind(len_yp)
        d_ij_sphere <- sphunif::Psi_mat( # coerce to dist class
          data = y2,
          use_ind_tri = TRUE,
          ind_tri = ind_tri
        )
        ind_dj <- comp_ind_dj(d_sphere)
        sph_mat <- dist_polysph_cross(x = y1, y = yl, ind_dj = ind_dj, norm_x = FALSE, norm_y = FALSE, std = FALSE)
        landmark_polysphere <- dist
        # Stress function (only sum the distinct distances and disregard diagonal)
        return(sum((landmark_polysphere - r_star * sph_mat)^2) / length(landmark_polysphere))
      }
 dist_initial <- dist_polysph_cross(x = cart_x[not_landmarks,], y = landmarks, norm_x = TRUE, norm_y = TRUE, ind_dj = ind_dj_poly, std = FALSE)
#res1<- remaining_stress(yp=yp,yn=yn, r_star = r_star, yl = yl, d_sphere = d_sphere, n = n, dist = dist_initial)


  res <- optim(
        fn = remaining_stress,
        par = c(yp),yn=yn, r_star = r_star, yl = yl, d_sphere = d_sphere, n = n, dist = dist_initial,
        method = "BFGS",
        control = list(reltol = tol)
      )

      y[not_landmarks,] <-
        matrix(res$par, nrow = nrow(yp), ncol = d_sphere + 1)
```
